column_description: Unique identifier for the transaction (primary key).
Identifier of the internal account to which this transaction belongs (foreign key to account table).
Date on which the transaction was recorded.
Category of the transaction; observed value "PRIJEM" likely means an incoming/credit transaction.
Specific operation type; observed codes include "VKLAD" (deposit) and "PREVOD Z UCTU" (transfer from another account).
Monetary amount of the transaction (positive integer, presumably in the account's currency).
Account balance after the transaction was applied.
Unclear – possibly a reference or purpose code associated with the transaction.
Bank identifier for external transactions; example value "AB" likely denotes a specific bank.
External account number involved in the transaction (e.g., 41403269); unclear if always external or sometimes internal.
